text.card: A red giant 1,276 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.92 solar masses and 8.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,668 K at its surface.
